TIME-01.attack: Two HTTP sessions: the first delays longer than the new whole-poll budget; the second counts requests.
TIME-01.before: Without the new CLI flag, the baseline waits for the first response and requests both sessions.
TIME-01.after_required: With --poll-timeout-ms below the first response delay, exit 2; the second endpoint receives zero requests; no report is created.
TIME-01.forbidden_pass: Treating a per-record transport error as a successful whole-poll budget, or starting the second request after deadline expiry.

TIME-02.attack: Missing, zero, non-numeric, or above-cap --poll-timeout-ms values.
TIME-02.after_required: Reject before registry or network I/O; accepted values may only lower the hard cap.
TIME-02.forbidden_pass: Silently selecting the default after a missing value or raising the cap.

JSON-01.attack: A schema-valid genesis Outbox carries mailbox nesting deeper than 64 JSON values.
JSON-01.before: The baseline accepts the open mailbox and reports verified.
JSON-01.after_required: Reject as invalid_json with an explicit depth-budget error before schema acceptance; with --fail-on-error exit 2.
JSON-01.forbidden_pass: Relying on serde_json's default recursion error or rejecting only closed schema fields.

JSON-02.attack: A schema-valid genesis Outbox carries 16384 scalar mailbox values, so the root container makes 16385 nodes.
JSON-02.before: The baseline accepts the document and reports verified.
JSON-02.after_required: Reject as invalid_json with an explicit node-budget error; 16383 scalars plus the root remain valid.
JSON-02.forbidden_pass: Counting only containers, resetting the budget per branch, or relying on the byte cap.

JSON-03.attack: The same over-budget document reaches Registry, Outbox, and LedgerSnapshot entry points.
JSON-03.after_required: All three strict entry points enforce the same depth and global node limits; duplicate-member behavior remains unchanged.
JSON-03.forbidden_pass: Protecting only HTTP documents while leaving config or snapshot restore unbounded.

evidence_required: request hit counters and elapsed-time observations
unit tests at exact depth and node boundaries
independent Python iterative depth/node oracle with known-answer self-tests
clean git-archive rebuild with an empty target directory
artifact hashes and explicit remaining DNS, process-memory, and execution debts
